supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: observable extension beyond the outer ocular margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle and chin area exhibit high-intensity (lighter/gray) pixel values compared to the low-intensity (dark) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin horizontal line with minor structural droop at the midline

other_distinctive_markers: extensive high-intensity (graying/balding) zone on the superior cranial vault
